name: SurgeGraph Skills
description: Workflow skills for setting up and operating SurgeGraph AI Visibility tracking and content production from any MCP-capable client.

skills.name: surge-setup-aeo-tracking
skills.description: End-to-end onboarding for SurgeGraph AI Visibility tracking — create a project, pick topics, generate tracking prompts, and apply tracking in bulk.

skills.name: surge-author-setup
skills.description: Create a SurgeGraph author and synthesize their writing voice from sample URLs or pasted content — then optionally link a WordPress author for the publishing byline.

skills.name: surge-brand-setup
skills.description: Configure a SurgeGraph project's brand identity — brand profile (identity, vocabulary, audience), Content Vision colors and featured-image style, and organization brand mentions.

skills.name: surge-weekly-visibility-review
skills.description: Produce a structured AI Visibility review for a SurgeGraph project — week-over-week deltas, sentiment shifts, top citing domains, gainers and losers per prompt, and emerging topics.

skills.name: surge-publish-to-wordpress
skills.description: Publish a SurgeGraph Writer document to a connected WordPress site — pick the document, verify the CMS integration, choose categories and an author, then send.

skills.name: surge-optimize-content
skills.description: Take an existing article and produce concrete AEO improvement recommendations grounded in SurgeGraph's response-structure, citation, and topic-gap data — then optionally generate an optimized version.

skills.name: surge-opportunities-to-content
skills.description: Turn SurgeGraph AI Visibility opportunities into a content production plan — pick the highest-value gaps, generate Writer documents seeded with the context, and optionally publish to WordPress.

skills.name: surge-competitor-citation-analysis
skills.description: Identify where competitors win AI citations the user doesn't — by tracked prompt, by topic, by citing domain — with concrete evidence and prioritized actions.

skills.name: surge-emerging-topics-monitor
skills.description: Surface new topics AI search engines are increasingly answering questions about in the user's space — topics not yet tracked, ranked by mention volume and adjacency.

skills.name: surge-topic-research-to-article
skills.description: Research a topic deeply with SurgeGraph topic research, then turn the research into a Writer article — outline, sub-topics, entities, and intent clusters all flow into the brief.

skills.name: surge-knowledge-library-bootstrap
skills.description: Create a SurgeGraph knowledge library and ingest a set of source documents so the Writer can ground future articles in real brand context instead of generic prose.

skills.name: surge-generate-image
skills.description: Generate brand-aligned images for an article using the project's Content Vision settings — brand palette, style, composition preferences are applied automatically.

skills.name: surge-page-citability-score
skills.description: Score a page or SurgeGraph document on AI-search extractability across five dimensions, with concrete rewrite suggestions per content block.

skills.name: surge-engine-optimizer
skills.description: Per-AI-engine optimization audit — diagnose why a brand is under-cited on ChatGPT vs. Google AI Overviews vs. Perplexity vs. Gemini vs. Bing Copilot, and produce platform-specific fixes.

skills.name: surge-ai-crawler-audit
skills.description: Audit a site's robots.txt for blocked AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, and more) and produce a corrected robots.txt.

skills.name: surge-brand-authority-scan
skills.description: Audit a brand's third-party platform presence — Wikipedia, Wikidata, and (planned) Reddit, YouTube, LinkedIn — to find authority gaps that affect AI search citation.

skills.name: surge-llmstxt-builder
skills.description: Generate or validate an llms.txt file for a domain — the emerging standard that gives AI systems a structured summary of a site's content, key pages, and business facts.

skills.name: surge-multi-client-portfolio-rollup
skills.description: Aggregate AI Visibility metrics across all projects in an organization for an agency portfolio view — one row per client, ranked by movement, sentiment, and citation share.

skills.name: surge-citation-momentum-tracker
skills.description: Identify external URLs (own pages and competitor pages) gaining or losing AI engine citations week-over-week — the page-level rising-and-falling view.

skills.name: surge-cross-client-anomaly-detector
skills.description: Across all projects in an organization, surface only the clients with statistically notable changes (gainers, losers, sentiment shifts, volatility spikes) — pre-filtered Monday-morning triage for agencies.

skills.name: surge-optimize-for-chatgpt
skills.description: Deep-dive optimization for getting cited specifically on ChatGPT — Wikipedia/Wikidata strategy, Bing index coverage, Reddit presence, comprehensive-article framing, and entity grounding.

skills.name: surge-optimize-for-aio
skills.description: Deep-dive optimization for Google AI Overviews (AIO) — organic top-10 ranking, question-based headings, direct answers, tables, FAQ structure, and featured-snippet overlap.

skills.name: surge-optimize-for-perplexity
skills.description: Deep-dive optimization for Perplexity AI — Reddit and forum presence, content freshness, original-data positioning, quotable-passage structure, and YouTube transcripts.

skills.name: surge-optimize-for-gemini
skills.description: Deep-dive optimization for Google Gemini — Knowledge Panel claiming, Google Business Profile, YouTube strategy, Schema.org markup, and Google ecosystem integrations.

skills.name: surge-optimize-for-bing-copilot
skills.description: Deep-dive optimization for Bing Copilot — Bing Webmaster Tools, IndexNow protocol for instant indexing, LinkedIn presence, GitHub for tech brands, and Microsoft ecosystem.
